details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from the official oven-sh GitHub release and executes a bundled 727KB file (math_init.js) with it. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated payload: its strings are encoded in a large array and decoded at runtime via a custom base64-style decoder, so its actual behavior is concealed from inspection. The package is a React UI component library and has no legitimate need to download a runtime and run an opaque obfuscated payload during installation. The payload's network destinations and data-handling behavior are hidden behind the obfuscation.
